items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: Shared hooks for Rad UI FX: reduced-motion detection (OS setting or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce"), run-once-in-view, and offscreen pausing.

accessibility: Honours both the OS Reduce motion setting and an in-app data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" ancestor.

items.name: blur-reveal
items.title: BlurReveal
items.description: Text that fades in from a soft blur, word by word or letter by letter. Screen readers get the whole sentence once; reduced motion shows it instantly.

accessibility: The full text is rendered once in a visually hidden span; the animated pieces are aria-hidden. Do not remove either.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce shows the text immediately, with no blur, movement or stagger.
Use the `as` prop to keep the correct heading level instead of wrapping in another heading.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types text out character by character with a caret. Screen readers get the full text immediately and nothing reflows while typing.

accessibility: The full text is in a visually hidden span; the typed copy and caret are aria-hidden.
An invisible copy of the final text reserves its size, so surrounding layout never shifts.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the full text at once with a still caret.
The caret stops blinking shortly after typing finishes.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: ScrambleText
items.description: Text that decodes from random characters into its final form, on view, on hover, or on mount.

accessibility: Screen readers only ever get the final text (visually hidden); the scrambling copy is aria-hidden.
Server render shows the final text, so content is readable before hydration.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) skips scrambling entirely.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: ShimmerText
items.description: A soft highlight sweeping across real, unsplit text.

accessibility: Text is never split, so screen readers, selection and translation work normally.
The base colour is currentColor: check its contrast; the highlight only brightens it briefly.
Forced-colours mode falls back to plain text.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) stops the sweep.

items.name: color-shift-text
items.title: ColorShiftText
items.description: Text filled with a slowly flowing multi-colour gradient.

accessibility: Text is never split.
Every colour in the gradient must meet contrast against the background, since any of them can sit under any letter.
Forced-colours mode falls back to plain text.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) freezes the gradient.

items.name: word-cycle
items.title: WordCycle
items.description: An inline slot that cycles through words, sized to the longest so the sentence never jumps.

accessibility: Screen readers hear every word once as a list ("fast, accessible or yours"), never a changing word.
Cycling pauses on hover and offscreen; pass `paused` from a visible control if it sits next to reading content (WCAG 2.2.2).
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the first word, still.

items.name: count-to
items.title: CountTo
items.description: A number that counts up to its value when it scrolls into view, formatted with Intl.NumberFormat.

accessibility: Screen readers get the final formatted value only; the ticking copy is aria-hidden.
Tabular figures prevent sideways jitter.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the final value without counting.

items.name: wave-text
items.title: WaveText
items.description: Letters that ripple in a travelling wave, continuously or on hover.

accessibility: The full text is read once from a visually hidden copy; the rippling letters are aria-hidden.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it, and `trigger="hover"` only moves under the pointer.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps the letters still.

items.name: glitch-text
items.title: GlitchText
items.description: Text that breaks into offset colour slices in short, occasional bursts.

accessibility: Bursts are brief and spaced seconds apart, staying well under 3 flashes per second (WCAG 2.3.1).
The colour layers are real aria-hidden elements, not ::before content that some screen readers announce; the text is read once.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) removes the glitch entirely.

items.name: marker-highlight
items.title: MarkerHighlight
items.description: A highlighter stroke that sweeps behind words as they scroll into view.

accessibility: Renders a real <mark> by default, so assistive tech knows the text is highlighted; use as="span" for decoration only.
Text keeps its own colour; pick a marker colour that keeps contrast with it.
Wrapped highlights get one stroke per line.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the full highlight immediately.

items.name: ink-underline
items.title: InkUnderline
items.description: A hand-drawn squiggle that draws itself under a word, on view or on hover.

accessibility: The squiggle is an aria-hidden SVG; the words are untouched.
`trigger="hover"` also draws on keyboard focus inside, so links get the same affordance.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the underline already drawn.

items.name: split-flap
items.title: SplitFlap
items.description: Departure-board tiles that flip through characters before landing on the text.

accessibility: Screen readers get the text once, as written; the tiles are aria-hidden.
Server render shows the final text, so it is readable before hydration.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the final tiles with no flipping.

items.name: morph-words
items.title: MorphWords
items.description: Words that melt into one another with a gooey liquid morph.

accessibility: Screen readers hear every word once as a list, never a changing word.
The gooey filter only runs mid-morph, so resting text stays crisp.
Pauses on hover and offscreen; `paused` stops it from a visible control (WCAG 2.2.2).
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) swaps words without blur or filter.

items.name: spotlight-text
items.title: SpotlightText
items.description: A pool of coloured light that follows the pointer across text.

accessibility: The real text always shows at its own colour and contrast; the light is an aria-hidden copy on top.
Pointer-driven only: nothing moves on its own.
Forced-colours mode drops the light.

items.name: extruded-text
items.title: ExtrudedText
items.description: Chunky 3D extruded lettering that tilts toward the pointer.

accessibility: Real, unsplit text; the depth is text-shadow.
Tilt is capped and off for touch input.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps the depth but disables the tilt.

items.name: circular-text
items.title: CircularText
items.description: Text running around a slowly turning circle, with an optional centre icon.

accessibility: The ring is an aria-hidden SVG; the text is read once, trimmed.
Pauses on hover and offscreen; `paused` stops it.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) stops the rotation.

items.name: neon-text
items.title: NeonText
items.description: A glowing neon sign with a rare, gentle flicker.

accessibility: Real, unsplit text.
The flicker is two short dips every 7 seconds, far below 3 flashes per second; turn it off with `flicker={false}`.
Use it on a dark surface and check contrast of the pale letters, not the glow.
Forced-colours mode drops the glow.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps the glow steady.

items.name: aurora-backdrop
items.title: AuroraBackdrop
items.description: Soft drifting colour glow behind any content. Decorative only, pauses offscreen, and stays still under reduced motion.

accessibility: The glow layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce keeps the colours but stops the drift.
The drift pauses automatically offscreen. If it runs behind content for long, give users a visible pause control wired to the `paused` prop (WCAG 2.2.2).
Check text contrast over the brightest part of the glow.

items.name: grid-backdrop
items.title: GridBackdrop
items.description: A perspective grid gliding toward the viewer and fading at the horizon.

accessibility: The grid is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) holds the grid still.

items.name: dot-field
items.title: DotField
items.description: A dim dot grid with a soft pool of light drifting across it.

accessibility: Both dot layers are aria-hidden and ignore pointer events.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) parks the light in the centre.

items.name: starfield
items.title: Starfield
items.description: A field of softly twinkling stars, generated from a seed so server and client match.

accessibility: Stars are aria-hidden and ignore pointer events.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps the stars, without twinkling.

items.name: meteor-shower
items.title: MeteorShower
items.description: Occasional streaks of light falling across the background.

accessibility: Meteors are aria-hidden and ignore pointer events.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) removes the meteors rather than freezing them mid-flight.

items.name: glow-card
items.title: GlowCard
items.description: A card whose surface lights up under the pointer, and around keyboard focus.

accessibility: The glow layer is aria-hidden; the card adds no roles or tab stops of its own.
Focus inside the card lights it too, so keyboard users get the same affordance.
Check text contrast with the glow at full strength.

items.name: perspective-card
items.title: PerspectiveCard
items.description: A card that tilts gently toward the pointer, with an optional glare.

accessibility: Tilt is capped (8° by default) to avoid vestibular discomfort.
Touch input never tilts, so scrolling past the card on mobile stays still.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) disables the tilt.
The glare is aria-hidden.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Pulls a button or link a little toward the pointer.

accessibility: Wraps the child in a span instead of cloning it, so the child keeps its role, props, ref and focus.
Keyboard focus and activation are unaffected.
Touch input never moves it.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) disables the pull.

items.name: click-burst
items.title: ClickBurst
items.description: A small burst of sparks from wherever a button is clicked.

accessibility: Sparks are aria-hidden, ignore pointer events and are removed after their animation.
Keyboard activation bursts from the centre of the element.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows no sparks.

items.name: reveal-on-scroll
items.title: RevealOnScroll
items.description: Content that fades and slides into place as it scrolls into view.

accessibility: Content is always in the DOM and the accessibility tree; only its opacity and position animate.
Keyboard focus landing inside hidden content reveals it immediately.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows content from the first paint.

items.name: orbit-border
items.title: OrbitBorder
items.description: A comet of light running around an element's border.

accessibility: The light is a pseudo-element: nothing is added to the accessibility tree.
Browsers without @property show a still highlight.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows a still highlight.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A seamless, infinitely scrolling row of items: logos, testimonials, tags.

accessibility: Items are exposed once; the looping copy is aria-hidden and inert, so nothing is read or focused twice.
Pauses on hover and whenever focus is inside; `paused` stops it from a visible control (WCAG 2.2.2).
Pass `label` to expose it as a named region.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) stops scrolling and wraps the items into a normal row.

items.name: sliding-tabs
items.title: SlidingTabs
items.description: Rad UI Tabs with an indicator that slides between triggers and content that fades in.

accessibility: Built on Rad UI Tabs: tablist/tab/tabpanel roles, arrow-key navigation and focus management come from the library.
The indicator is aria-hidden decoration.
Focus-visible outline is kept on triggers.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) snaps the indicator and skips the fade.
